notif_pause_description: Stops notifications on every device for a while. Unread counts still update.
notif_paused_until: Notifications are paused on every device until {until}.
notif_quiet_description: Every day in this window, no device pops up a notification; unread counts still update.
notif_preview_description: What a notification shows, on every device.
notif_sound_description: Play a sound with a notification, on every device.
notif_mobile_title: While I am at my computer, my phone
notif_mobile_description: Only delays what would ring on your phone; unread counts still update. Only activity in CoForge on the web counts as using your computer.
notif_mobile_immediate: Notifies right away, even while I use my computer
notif_mobile_inactive: Waits until my computer is inactive
notif_mobile_idle_1m: Waits 1 minute after I stop on my computer
notif_mobile_idle_2m: Waits 2 minutes after I stop on my computer
notif_mobile_idle_5m: Waits 5 minutes after I stop on my computer
notif_mobile_idle_10m: Waits 10 minutes after I stop on my computer
notif_save_failed: Notification settings could not be saved. Try again.
notif_save_conflict: These settings were just changed on another device. The latest values are shown; try again.
notif_load_failed: Notification settings could not be loaded.
notif_failure_removed: the subscription is no longer valid; turn notifications off and on again
notif_failure_unreachable: its push service could not be reached
notif_off_note: Message notifications are off, so these settings do nothing until you turn them on.
notif_pause_custom_invalid: Pick a time within the next year.
notif_test_sent_hint: Test notification sent. If it didn't appear, check that notifications for this site are allowed in your browser and system settings, and that Do Not Disturb is off.
notif_this_device_none_hint: Turn on message notifications above and allow them in the browser.
